comment: Professor Cook is a great professor who has a ton of experience in data analytics and decision-making. This class isn't the easiest and covers a bunch of softwares (Access, Tableau, Excel) and processes (Monte-Carlo, Optimization, Visualization, etc.) in a fast pace. There is an end of year presentation and he is very helpful with assignments.

Dr. Cook is an effective communicator of the material from slides that he posts to Blackboard. Quizzes are open notes. The test questions are exactly like the homework with changed numbers. Really funny guy too. Lots of real-world experience that he can bring into class which makes the material more digestible. I'd recommend him for OM and IT Data.
